body: The cut potato with a soil jar are tied in one bundle. a greasy sheen marks the field side; torn warning tape marks the other.
title: Cut potato with a soil jar at at Tuesday dawn

body: My sister was brought from the treated rows before anybody called the ambulance. The crew asked for her work clothes to be put in a separate sack. By the time they reached us, three neighbors who never entered the field had the same burning eyes.
title: Harvest at the stretcher
